push.evidence: Focused Livewire tests verify accepted endpoint persistence, per-user list/remove/test scoping, cross-user rejection and queued DeliverPush dispatch without rendering endpoint or key material. PR8's headed persistent-Chrome matrix live-verifies subscription, real database-queue delivery, notification display, cross-user denial, own removal and logout cleanup.

webhooks.evidence: Independent local HTTP receiver verifies actual queued delivery and persisted native bot reply; PHPUnit verifies no callback loop. PR8 canonicalizes every address through one classifier: IPv4 must first belong to a positive public-unicast class and then survive subtraction of IANA non-global, special, multicast and reserved ranges, while IPv6 must first belong to 2000::/3 and then survive subtraction of documentation, benchmarking, ORCHIDv2, Teredo, 6to4 and the remaining non-global special-purpose ranges. Explicit globally reachable exceptions are preserved. The classifier governs literal saves, validation, DNS answers and the normalized address passed to the cURL connection pin. Permanent reproducer and top-nibble tests verify the allowlist structure. A real Guzzle cURL-handler test proves the pin, redirect refusal and unknown-length 20 MiB ceiling.

jobs.evidence: Native durable auxiliary worker executes real delivery; PHPUnit checks afterCommit and rollback. PR8's PostgreSQL run uses a separate PHP 8.5 database queue worker and finishes with zero queued or failed jobs.
